fractionation_method.evidence: Desalted TMT-labelled peptides were fractionated using high pH reverse phase chromatography on a C18 column (150 × 2.1 mm i.d. - Kinetex EVO (5 μm, 100 Å)) on a HPLC system (Agilent, LC 1260 Infinity II, Agilent).

fragmentation_method.evidence: Higher energy collisional dissociation fragmentation was performed on the 10 most intense ions for the Q-Exactive HF, or during a 3 sec cycle time for the Fusion Lumos.

ionization_type.evidence: Eluting peptides were electrosprayed into the mass spectrometer using a nanoelectrospray ion source (Thermo Scientific).
